test(watcher): carry the 8th catalogue category in proof-thread-indexer fixtures

e2575bb6 (Q44 registration) grew the deployment policy's fraud-proof
catalogue to 8 categories; the test-local familyNames table still
listed 7, so verifyDeploymentAuthority's exact-cardinality check
(proof-thread-indexer.ts:1651) correctly rejected every context and 12
tests flipped to reject (the duplicate_key throws were secondary -
rejected stages never advanced the durable store). No production
defect; the identical file passes 17/17 at e2575bb6^.

Fix is fixture-only and strictly stronger: da-hash-preimage prepended
(ascending familyId), hashes read from the recomputed helper fixture
(never hand-written), and the stale toHaveLength(7)/first-family
assertions replaced with pins to the production category order so a
future addition fails loudly here. 17/17 (the historically flaky case
passed in 9.7s); state-queue-indexer 19/19; deployment-identity 18/18;
tsc/eslint/prettier clean.
goal(progress): W24 queue row PASS at b9131b2b; proof-thread-indexer regression recorded

feat(W24): Phase A verifier - canonical semantics only, differential-proven

New demo/midgard-watcher/src/phase-a-verifier.ts: a thin adapter with
zero watcher-authored validation predicates - every verdict comes from
validatePhaseASingle imported from @al-ft/midgard-validation/phase-a
under the recorded CG3 waiver. Evidence arrives root-authenticated via
the Q03 core (same call as W22); the W22 reconstruction record is
re-verified (recomputed digest, accept action, header/payload identity);
PhaseAConfig derives from the L1-committed header, never the payload's
claim; the sidecar projection uses the canonical reachability
computation and on any throw hands the COMPLETE set to Phase A. Frozen
digest-bound result with exact canonical code/stage/detail per rejected
tx and W23 rejection selection.

Published reachable/excluded code table (waiver condition b): 49 codes
-> 32 reachable (21 evidenced, 11 dominated with dominating-code
boundary proofs) / 17 excluded with one-line justifications; corrects
the waiver text - E_MIN_FEE is Phase-A reachable (header-committed
minFeeA/minFeeB), evidenced. Differential evidence: 26-entry corpus
asserted byte-identical to the canonical result per entry, plus one-way
never-accept-what-canon-rejects, batch, and independent block-level
differentials. Mutation probe: 21/22 killed; three real gaps closed
with tests (notably the empty-sidecar fallback that could have made
the watcher more permissive than the operator); the one survivor is a
forward-drift tripwire, documented.

Evidence: new suite 94/94; scaffold 5/5, rule-bundle 9/9,
canonical-block-store 46/46, header-root-reconstruction 59/59
unchanged; tsc/eslint/prettier clean. Gate registration: phaseAVerifier
(94), 17 files; dependency-map verifier exit 0 on the staged index.
Known committed-tree regression reported separately: 12
proof-thread-indexer assertion failures from the Q44 registration's
manifest arms (repair lane dispatched).
goal(progress): Q13 prepare slice at 0e808400; 19-input proof-fit finding recorded

feat(Q13): input-no-idx off-chain evidence, prepare tooling, and step-02/03 selectors

First of the seven missing per-family off-chain surfaces (F20-02
residue). SDK module defines the canonical evidence (exact TS twin of
bad_input_output_index >= len(outputs_preimage)), the full 4-step
PlutusData ABI including the previously missing output-preimage
schemas, and Q03-only security-grade admission (node/file routes are
labelled diagnostic and cannot mint a claim). Resumable prepare emits
five artifacts covering all four submit steps with an 8-code typed
rejection enum; valid-block negatives on both planes.

Proof-fit measured complete-item-first per §3.2 and recorded in
step-02.ak: the complete spend-inputs preimage fits the 20%% execution
reserve only up to 19 inputs (12,718,812 mem / 5,654,474,206 cpu);
20 inputs passes the raw limit but fails the reserve (a §3.3 failing
result); the 296-input Cardano boundary is 11.2x over the raw limit
while the profile admits maxSpendInputCount 16384. No chunking added -
the direct path stays enabled and a §3.2 necessity artifact is owed
above 19 inputs (parent/F05 decision).

Evidence: step selectors 2/2 + 3/3 (new) + 2/2 (new) + 2/2 via the
guarded runner; prepare suite 16/16; sdk fault-proof/proof-abi 21/21
(baseline 19); regressions 77/77; typecheck/lint/prettier clean. Submit
modules deliberately deferred - they need the parent-owned contracts.ts
applied-chain registration (F20-01 items recorded in the ledger).
goal(progress): Q24/Q25 structural-N/A queue rows at e9797e90

test(Q24/Q25): executable structural-N/A proofs - ada-minted and negative-output-value unrepresentable

Per GOAL_SPEC §9.1, prose N/A is insufficient: both rows now carry
executable adversarial proofs. Q24: the ADA asset class cannot appear as
a mint entry - every canonical mint encoder gates the policy key on a
28-byte hash (preimages.ak:330/:348/:518); violating CBOR a140a14005
and the 27-byte near-miss reject, adjacent 28-byte controls pass (7/7).
Q25: output values cannot carry negative lovelace or qty<=0 on either
decode path (components.ak:410-411/:382/:253, encoder :373,
ledger-output-v1.ak:231/:129); ten rejection vectors each differ from
their passing control by exactly one byte (13/13). Byte-identical
TypeScript twins against decodeMidgardNativeMint and
decodeMidgardTxOutput/decodeMidgardValue (9/9). catalogue-status rows
annotated with the executable N/A.

Pinned aiken v1.1.22+39d6b04 focused runner: collected == passed ==
requested for both modules; aiken check --skip-tests clean; core tsc/
eslint/prettier clean.

goal(triage): Q23-Q48 classification - 14 structural-N/A, 8 needs-family, 3 owner decisions

Catalogue planning number for Q50: 19-22 families. Deployed
validation-trace dispute machine covers most proposed rows; stale
fault-proof docs overstate the gap. Six of 14 on-chain families are
unregistered in the catalogue. Q27/Q32/Q43 escalated OWNER-DECIDE.

fix(Q02): reject free-text comment breakout in family scaffold specs

Adversarial verification of the scaffold generator found spec free-text
fields (summary, violationId, rule, doc) unconstrained: a crafted doc or
summary could break out of an emitted comment and inject an accept-any
Aiken predicate whose multi-line body the line-based permissive-dispatch
scanner cannot see. requireText now rejects control characters and
comment tokens (unsafe_text) at the strict parser - the right gate,
before emission. New regression covers four injection shapes across all
four fields. Suite 44 -> 45/45; tsc/eslint/prettier clean.

Clause verdicts (Q02 acceptance): boilerplate-only PASS (every rule
point is a loud todo; assertGeneratedTestsFailLoudV1 rejects vacuous
green); explicit schemas/tests PASS (throwaway-family generation
inspected); no dynamic accept-any dispatch PASS (permissive-dispatch-v1
is a 15-rule detector applied to the generator's own output; production
dispatch is a closed union).

goal(q5x): F04 scoped PASS, Q56 circular deps fixed, program dispositions recorded

D1 executed (F04 ACCEPTED sections unblock Q53/Q61/Q63 local work; CG5
binding stays owner-gated), D8 executed (Q56 dependsOn drops QG1-QG3),
D2/D3/D4 recorded as OWNER-DECIDE escalations, D5/D6/D9 adopted
(Q58a/b/c split, Q23-Q48 structural-N/A triage commissioned, Q52
reclassified XL pending decomposition).

test(Q44): da-hash-preimage emulator lifecycle - init, both steps, token, removal

Full §9.1 output-9 journey on a real Lucid Emulator against the real
Aiken step validators, driven by the production submitters: miskeyed
tail leaf proven end to end (init -> step-01 binds foreign/derived ids
-> on-chain step-02 datum equals the off-chain-derived triple -> token
minted, thread burned -> fraudulent block removed, operator slashed,
token retained), and the valid-block negative on both reachable planes
(off-chain guard refuses to build; on-chain PHAS membership rejects an
invented key). Falsification check run and reverted: honest-key fixture
fails at step-01, so the suite is sensitive, not vacuous. Shared
support additive-only (+24: realDaHashPreimage arm).

Evidence: new suite 2/2; emulator replays 3/3 + 12/12 + 3/3 across the
suites sharing the support file; typecheck/lint/prettier clean.
Step-02's non-violating-triple refusal is unreachable via the emulator
by construction and is covered by the Aiken rejection selectors.

goal(w24): declare midgard-validation watcher dependency; record CG3-waiver dispositions

P0 prerequisite for the W24 wave per the scoping brief: validation
package declared (scaffold mirror 5/5, lockfile, dist built), stale
W24-W27 manifest rows refreshed, and the D1-D6 dispositions recorded in
the ledger with the narrow CG3 waiver flagged OWNER-RATIFY.
